Keycloak.//: the realm of the Keycloak in ../keycloak; KEYCLOAK_ISSUER overrides it

Receiver.//: TransmitterIssuer and OAuth2:TokenUri are derived from Keycloak:Issuer in Program.cs

Stream.//: the application registers its own PUSH stream on startup, Keycloak assigns the audience

Push.//: how Keycloak (in Docker) reaches the push endpoint, must be allowed by 'ssf.validPushUrls' of the client; SSF_PUSH_URL overrides it
Push.//ExpectedAuthHeader: the stream is created with this authorization header, Keycloak sends it with every SET

OAuth2.//: the service account of the client manages the stream; KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_SECRET overrides the secret

Revocation.//: at least the access token lifespan of the realm (5 minutes by default)
